card.name: Partway through rare foreign words
card.fires_on: Pieces in the middle of rare or foreign words, mainly Lao script characters split into bytes, and the start of Fentanyl after F. Also seen in odd words like ketchup, Bekenner and Abyssinia.

modes.label: Lao script bytes
modes.description: Broken-up Lao characters in the motto of Laos.

modes.label: Fentanyl after F
modes.description: The second piece of the drug name Fentanyl at the start of label sentences.
modes.example: Instructions F<<entanyl>> transdermal system should be prescribed only
